measured_with_gd_tools_0_4_0.line_obligations_result: Statement-line obligations above (4, 6, 8, 9) matched correctly across the true-only and false-only runs. Line 4 (`var outcome: int`, no initializer) has NO trackable point in gd-tools' plan at all -- a real completeness gap, not reflected in the obligations above since gd-tools never gets the chance to hit-or-miss a line it doesn't track. See pilot/adapter-run/f020_if_both_outcomes/compare.py for the branch-tracking finding: gd-tools' if_true branch counter fires on every evaluation of the decision (line 5), not on the true outcome specifically, so it reports 100% branch coverage even in the false-only run where the true body (line 6) never executed.
